title: Counit equation for the transported isomorphism
statement:
theorem isomorphic_single_tensor_counit_transport_equation
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (k : Y ⟶ Z), (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback k).Additive]
    {X P Z : Scheme.{u}} (p : P ⟶ X) (e : Z ≅ P) :
    let c := @Classical.choose _ _ (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
      (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition.{u, w})))
    let a := fun {A B : Scheme.{u}} (s : A ⟶ B) ↦
      Classical.choose (exists_schemeDerivedAdjunction s
        (hAdd := (Classical.choose exists_derivedPullbackComposition) s)
        ((Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition)) s)
        ((Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec
          (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition))) s))
    let t := Classical.choose (exists_isomorphic_single_tensor_counit_transport p e)
    ∀ M : X.Modules,
      let K := (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj M
      (a e.hom).unit.app ((derivedPullback p).obj K) ≫
          (schemeDerivedDirectImage e.hom).map
            ((c e.hom p).hom.app K ≫ pinnedSingleTensorCounit (e.hom ≫ p) 0 M) ≫
          t.hom.app M = pinnedSingleTensorCounit p 0 M

source.place: Derived pullback composition and adjunction transport

proof.text: Evaluate the defining leftDerivedLift factorization of the selected composition comparison at the homotopy single of M. The termwise mapped-single comparisons commute with a natural composition isomorphism: check degree zero using to_single_hom_ext, and apply the homotopy quotient. Naturality of the selected counit then gives c(e.hom,p).hom at M[0] followed by the pinned single tensor counit for e.hom ≫ p as derivedPullback(e.hom) of the pinned single tensor counit for p, followed by the pinned single tensor counit for e.hom and the single image of the specified underived tensor mate.

Use the selected derived adjunction for e.hom and the inverse-component equation of the specified transport. Unit naturality rewrites the direct image of the preceding composition as the pinned single tensor counit for p followed by the inverse component of the transport.

Postcompose with the hom component of the same transport. The inverse-hom identity and the category identity law give exactly the desired counit equation. All calculations hold for zero modules and empty schemes and do not invert the counit for p.
